main.description: Pushes one social.colibri.beta.emoji.follow record to the AppView, so it takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a sync notification. The client writes or deletes the record in its own preferences space first, then calls this. The AppView starts tracking the subject's owner and answers with the followed item as the picker shows it.

subject.description: The followed pack or emoji. Absent means the record was deleted.

createdAt.description: The record's createdAt. Defaults to the time of the call when subject is present.

follow.description: The followed item. Absent after an unfollow.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: EmojiNotFound
errors.description: The subject is an emoji that does not exist.

errors.name: PackNotFound
errors.description: The subject is a pack that does not exist.

errors.name: UnsupportedProvider
errors.description: The subject's collection belongs to no supported emoji provider.

errors.name: OwnEmoji
errors.description: The subject is in the requesting user's own repo.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The subject owner's repo could not be read.
